# CANDIDATE: VWAP_PULLBACK_RIBBON_CONFLUENCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In a strong intraday uptrend defined by bullish EMA ribbon alignment (EMA9>EMA20>EMA50), a shallow pullback to the VWAP (within 0.1%) on a bullish candle with above-average volume presents a high-probability long entry as the trend resumes. This edge exists because the VWAP acts as dynamic support in trending markets, and the ribbon alignment filters for genuine trend strength rather than countertrend noise.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Trigger occurs when all conditions are met on the same 5-minute bar:  
(1) EMA9 > EMA20 > EMA50 (bullish ribbon alignment),  
(2) Price crosses below VWAP by ≤ 0.1% (touch or slight penetration),  
(3) Bar close > bar open (bullish candle),  
(4) Volume > 1.2 × 20-period average volume.  
Enter long at the close of the trigger bar.  

**Exit:**  
- Initial stop: Lowest low of the prior 3 bars (chart stop).  
- Initial target: 1.5R (risk-reward based on initial stop distance).  
- After hitting 1R: Trail remaining position with chandelier exit (ATR × 3) OR move stop to break-even, whichever is tighter.  
- Time stop: 15:50 ET (0DTE constraint).  
**Regime filters:** Only consider trades when VIX < 20 and time is between 09:45–11:30 EST; skip during FOMC windows or high-news volatility periods.
